scope: Official Symmetry:Symmetry preset listing demo partially inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility tree. Home screenshot captured; collection and Borderline One Piece PDP inspected. PDP route was truncated, cart inspected read-only with no shopper actions, viewport/mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Symmetry:Symmetry listing View demo opened the Chantilly storefront.

claims.observed: Homepage combines campaign and category-led fashion discovery; All Our Products collection lists 68 products with category links, filter entry, Featured sort and varied card states. Empty cart provides Start Shopping and a Before you go... best-seller carousel.
claims.risk: No collection controls were operated; stock, rating and promotion content are merchant-provided and unverified. Cart cross-sell and rating content were not interacted with or verified.
claims.vsn_guard: Keep category, filter and sort affordances understandable and verify card states against current catalog data.

claims.observed: Borderline One Piece PDP was rendered with color/size choices, fit guide, stock copy, Add to Cart and related products.
claims.risk: Exact PDP URL was truncated in browser output; variants, fit, stock, sustainability, and recommendation accuracy were not tested.
claims.vsn_guard: Verify variant, fit, inventory and related-product data against product records before design decisions.

claims.observed: Empty cart offers a Start Shopping route and a best-seller carousel with prices, preorder labels and ratings.
claims.risk: No cart actions or checkout were tested; displayed ratings and availability are unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Provide a clear return-to-shopping path and keep cart recommendations' availability and reviews current.
